claims.title: Capacity changes more than storage space
claims.statement: Samsung specifies the 500 GB model with 512MB LPDDR4 and the 1 TB model with 1GB LPDDR4. Listed sequential reads are up to 3,400 and 3,400 MB/s respectively. Sequential writes are up to 2,300 versus 2,500 MB/s with TurboWrite; beyond the TurboWrite region, the listed rates are 600 versus 1,200 MB/s.
claims.limits: Manufacturer specification comparison, not measurements on our hardware. Firmware, host and TurboWrite conditions matter. Datasheet tests use IOmeter 1.1.0, Windows 10 and an Intel Core i7-7700K. Raw source units retained.
claims.locator: p. 5, DRAM and performance table, footnote 3; p. 6, test configuration
claims.verifier_note: Manufacturer up-to performance; TurboWrite-dependent writes; no independent measurements. Raw DRAM units retained.

claims.title: Which packages are on a particular production revision?
claims.statement: What exact NAND/DRAM package count, part markings and board positions apply to a particular 500GB production revision?
claims.limits: The reviewed documents establish constituent descriptions and capacities, not revision-specific package counts, markings or positions. Resolve with revision-matched assembly documentation or an attributable teardown with clear image rights. The diagram remains conceptual.
claims.locator: pp. 4–5, System Design Flexibility and Hardware Information
claims.verifier_note: Reviewed sources do not establish revision-specific package identity, count or position. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that no such documentation exists.
